description: Update a Chat channel's name, description, topic, visibility or archived state (ClickUp Chat v3). Only the provided fields change. Returns the updated channel.

archived.description: Set true to archive the channel, false to unarchive it.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel to update.

description.description: New description. Omit to keep current.

name.description: New channel name. Omit to keep current.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

topic.description: New topic. Omit to keep current.

visibility.description: Change visibility to PUBLIC or PRIVATE.

name: update_chat_channel
